default.tagline: The cloud home for the next generation of design platforms.
default.heroSupport: Design systems, real-time collaboration, AI generation, and versioned assets all live in the cloud. desigrs.cloud is the category-defining name for that infrastructure.

valueProps.title: Cloud-native design systems
valueProps.body: Modern design platforms treat tokens, components, and documentation as living infrastructure. Owning desigrs.cloud positions a product at the intersection of design systems and cloud delivery.

valueProps.title: Real-time creative collaboration
valueProps.body: From multiplayer canvases to shared libraries and approval flows, the best design tools are cloud-first. This domain signals that architecture immediately.

valueProps.title: AI design infrastructure
valueProps.body: Generative models, prompt libraries, and evaluation pipelines for design are increasingly hosted as cloud services. desigrs.cloud is a natural home for that category.

valueProps.title: Design ops & platform teams
valueProps.body: Internal design platforms, component marketplaces, and governance tools need a clear, authoritative identity. This domain provides it.

trends.title: Design systems as products
trends.body: Companies productize their design systems for external developers and partners. Cloud delivery and versioning become table stakes.

trends.title: Multiplayer & edge design
trends.body: Low-latency collaborative editing and edge-rendered previews are becoming expected features of professional design tooling.

trends.title: Generative design pipelines
trends.body: AI that produces production-ready components, variations, and accessibility checks is moving from experiment to core cloud service.

trends.title: Token & asset infrastructure
trends.body: Design tokens, 3D assets, motion libraries, and brand kits are managed like code — with CI, environments, and distribution.

trends.title: Design + engineering convergence
trends.body: Cloud platforms that bridge Figma-like authorship with production code and design tokens reduce handoff friction dramatically.

trends.title: Enterprise design platforms
trends.body: Large organizations are consolidating design tools into internal platforms. A premium .cloud domain carries institutional weight.

seoPoints.title: Category keyword pairing
seoPoints.body: “Designers” + “cloud” is a natural and searchable combination for platforms, agencies, and SaaS products targeting design teams.

seoPoints.title: Memorable & brandable
seoPoints.body: Short, pronounceable, and instantly evocative of modern design infrastructure. Easy to type and hard to forget.

seoPoints.title: Trust at the edge
seoPoints.body: Served from Cloudflare’s global network, the site itself demonstrates the performance and reliability expected of a cloud-native design brand.
